// Circle App Kit import — top of src/App.tsx
import { AppKit } from '@circle-fin/app-kit'
import { createViemAdapterFromProvider } from '@circle-fin/adapter-viem-v2'

// AppKit instance
const appKit = new AppKit()

// Bridge handler — called when user taps Bridge button
const handleBridge = useCallback(async () => {
  const adapter = await createViemAdapterFromProvider({ provider: rawProvider })
  await appKit.bridge({
    token: 'USDC',
    from: { adapter, chain: bridgeFrom.kitName },
    to:   { adapter, chain: 'Arc' },
    amount: bridgeAmount,
  })
  toast.success(`Bridged ${bridgeAmount} USDC to Arc!`)
}, [connectorClient, bridgeAmount, bridgeFrom])

src/App.tsx — USDC contract address + balance read USDC on Arc 
// USDC is the native gas token on Arc mainnet
// ERC-20 address used for all transfers, approvals, and balance reads
const USDC_ADDRESS = '0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000' as const
const USDC_DECIMALS = 6
const ARC_CHAIN_ID  = 5042 // Arc mainnet

// Read USDC balance via ERC-20 balanceOf
const { data: usdcBalance } = useReadContract({
  address:      USDC_ADDRESS,
  abi:          erc20Abi,
  functionName: 'balanceOf',
  args:         [address],
  chainId:      ARC_CHAIN_ID,
})

// Send USDC via ERC-20 transfer
const { writeContractAsync } = useWriteContract()
await writeContractAsync({
  address:      USDC_ADDRESS,
  abi:          erc20Abi,
  functionName: 'transfer',
  args:         [payTo, parseUnits(payAmount, USDC_DECIMALS)],
  chainId:      ARC_CHAIN_ID,
})
